note: Demo Sessions are synthetic. They were produced by the Anonymizer (scripts/anonymize.ts): every free-text string, path and name was replaced with same-length placeholder text, while Record order, Record types and the Measured Tokens of every API Call were kept exactly. The token dynamics are real; none of the words are.

sessions.name: Small session
sessions.description: Five API Calls barely denting a 1M window — 45k of it. Almost two thirds of that is System, so it shows what a session costs before any work happens.

sessions.name: Medium session
sessions.description: Sixty-two API Calls reaching a tenth of a 1M window, and the only Demo Session in which all six Categories are present, memory files included.

sessions.name: Large session
sessions.description: Two hundred sixty-one API Calls filling half a 1M window. The context drops back four times without a compaction — Claude Code shedding older context — and attribution restarts at each drop.
